title: First vertical slice
context: ClearPath needs one complete hero-to-quote entry experience that proves the visual direction and mobile usability before the rest of the site is built.

stories.title: Create the ClearPath project and implementation brief
stories.outcome: The story is understood and the project has a reproducible baseline.
stories.context: Review the client brief, discovery notes, and design handoff before scaffolding the application.
acceptanceCriteria: A separate clearpath-home repository is created with the curriculum bootstrap command
README states user, business goal, scope, non-goals, and source documents
A component inventory and acceptance plan are committed before UI implementation
stories.dataContract: Static typed configuration for business facts and navigation.

expectations.accessibility: Plan semantic landmarks and heading order.
expectations.analytics: Name quote-start and phone-click events but do not implement yet.

stories.title: Build responsive navigation and hero
stories.outcome: A visitor understands the service area and can begin a quote or phone call quickly.
stories.context: Use the approved content hierarchy and only verifiable trust statements. Mobile traffic is the primary design case.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation, hero promise, service area, trust proof, primary quote CTA, and secondary phone CTA are present
Layout works at 375px, 768px, and 1440px without horizontal overflow
All controls have visible keyboard focus and understandable labels
Repeated trust items are rendered from typed data rather than duplicated markup
stories.dataContract: Business config contains name, service area, phone display/raw values, and trust statements.

expectations.security: Do not use unsafe HTML injection.
expectations.accessibility: Semantic header/nav/main, one page h1, focus-visible controls, reduced motion.

definitionOfDone: Responsive and keyboard evidence is attached

stories.title: Correct mobile hero overflow
stories.outcome: The hero remains usable on narrow devices and at text zoom.
stories.context: At 320px width and 200% text zoom, the CTA row creates horizontal scrolling and clips the phone action.
acceptanceCriteria: The issue reproduces before the change and no longer reproduces after it
Actions stack or wrap without losing meaning
The fix does not regress the desktop layout
stories.seededBug: Apply a non-wrapping CTA row with a fixed minimum width in the learner project, then diagnose it with browser tools.
